statements.statement: The patient has recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to these embolic events
The diagnosis of transient neurological deficits related to embolic phenomena is documented as G45.9
The denial reason code is PR-204
